events.title: DEMO UPDATE v1.0.1 - Patch Notes

events.title: Play the Demo Today
events.summary: Hello everyone. The wait is officially over. The playable Demo of DIARY: WHITE is now available on Steam. We are incredibly excited to finally share this first look with you.This demo offers a complete experience of the opening chapter, allowing you to immerse yourself in the psychological horror atmosphere and try out the core point and click investigation mechanics.
